code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = {
                (r, c), (c, r), (h - 1 - r, w - 1 - c),
                (w - 1 - c, h - 1 - r), (r, w - 1 - c),
                (h - 1 - r, c), (c, h - 1 - r), (w - 1 - c, r),
            }
            known = [grid[a][b] for a, b in orbit if a < h and b < w and grid[a][b] != 2]
            if known:
                out[r][c] = known[0]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
